data.title: Early ballots and how campaigns are using AI with Optiq Data Co-Founder Cole Patterson
data.description: Cole Patterson, co-founder of Optiq Data, shared his insight into how political campaigns in California are using artificial intelligence and provided a look at early ballot numbers ahead of the November election.
data.author: Ashley Zavala
